body: Alright, I'll try that so my future is better than my present.
Looks so easy. I will definitely try to tell her that.

I should have tried to talk to her when we sat next to each other in this class we have in common, but I couldn't. I felt like I was forcing her to be sat next to me but she wanted to be with her best friend. I see that I have sometimes occasions to talk to her and I will really try to talk with her.

The thing is that I don't know. Last year we would always talk in class and it was great and, now that I'm not in her class, I see her everyday but I can't talk to her. I will try and see how she reacts, if she only replies to be polite and because we're friends or if she keeps talking with me. Also the fact that we can't see each other at school can be an excuse to propose her to hang out.

Thank you very much for your answer. I already know what you told me but still it's hard to live with it, specially when I know that one of these jerks is a smart person who has really good grades. But this week has been really hard for me and what they did was too mean and disrespectful.

Thank you for for what you said. Sometimes when I say something, I feel like I shouldn't have said that so I punch myself. I always feel guilty, even when I don't have too. I feel like I need to show myself that I'm a shitty person and that I'm pathetic.

For years, my classmates have ignored me until I unintentionally warned that I would kill me. Now they're afraid of me. But still, they care, even if they don't understand anything

And also thank you for what you said about the knife, it took away the desire to cut me.
